washing_state: initial fabric; no durability washing reported
composition: 100% goat hair from the Hasi region of Albania; plain weave, warp 23 and weft 34 yarns per 10 cm
TGA_specimen_preparation: Methods p 3 call the TG specimen 5 mg of goat fibres; results p 4, Figure 2 caption, Table 3 caption and conclusion p 6 explicitly assign the TG to the Hasi goat fabric. Fabric aliquot handling, cutting, pan and pretreatment are not specified.
title: Properties of goat fibres from selected Albanian regions
journal: IOP Conference Series: Materials Science and Engineering 459, 012050; AITAE 2018
treatment_method: Goat hair sheared directly from the midrib region; 500 g sampled per geographic region under ISO 1130:1975. Only Hasi-region hair was made into the studied 100% goat-hair plain-woven fabric. Yarn-making and weaving processes, areal density, cleaning and conditioning are not reported.
LOI_specimen_preparation: Hasi-region plain-woven goat-hair fabric; three repetitions reported. Specimen size and conditioning not stated.
TG_locator: Original Table 3, printed p 4: Tonset5% 92 C, Tmax1 247 C, Tmax2 526 C, residue at 800 C 4.9%; accompanying prose and conclusion corroborate. Tonset5% is mapped to T5_C only.
LOI_locator: Original Table 2, printed p 4: three repetitions of goat fabric LOI 41. Text printed p 3 says same results for three repetitions; conclusion p 6 corroborates.
conditions_locator: Original printed p 2: Hasi fabric construction and ISO 4589:1996 Dynisco LOI; p 3: Pyris 1 and 5 mg; p 4 Figure 2 caption: air and 10 C/min.
pairing_evidence: Methods identify the only woven fabric as Hasi-region 100% goat hair. The results explicitly say TGA of goat fabric, and conclusion explicitly groups LOI, TGA and MCC of the goat fabric from Hasi. The methods and row labels generically call TG material fibres/hair; this is preserved and requires parent source QA. Five geographic fibre populations supply mechanical tests only and are not five paired states.
source_location: Complete indexed original publication, six printed article pages plus cover. Methods pp 2-3, Tables 2-3 and Figure 2 caption p 4, conclusion p 6. Original indexed text is clear; original PDF pixels were not accessible and are not claimed.
limitations: Source Tmax 247/526 C means maximum temperature of first/second weight loss, without an explicit maximum-rate or DTG definition. Canonical Tmax fields are blank and values retained only as source-native temperatures. One prepared fabric state, not five region states or three replicate states. No SD or mean was calculated from equal LOI repetitions. The prose calls Tonset5% a degradation onset, but the explicit 5% definition is preserved as T5_C. No TGA flow, program endpoints, pan or uncertainty are inferred; 800 C belongs to the tabulated residue. Nitrogen 80 mL/min, 1 K/s, triplicate tests and 0.24 residue belong to MCC and are excluded. Public metadata and cover citation report 2018 while article running imprint says 2019; original imprint retained separately. Methods call the 5 mg TG aliquot goat fibres; repeated specific fabric assignments support the crosswalk but are disclosed for independent QA. Official PDF retrieval returned a Radware challenge page; no challenge was attempted. Original evidence is the full indexed author-posted publication, not a summary.
source_material_form_TGA_raw: Methods: 5 mg of goat fibres. Results and Figure 2/Table 3 captions: goat fabric; table row: goat hair.
